scenario: WF-3b ([LNUL.4.1] / [LNUL.5.1]) — `s.state + 1 > 5` does NOT fire on a null reading. Arithmetic propagates null exactly as comparison does, so the predicate is null and null does not fire ([LNUL.4.3]). fact_count 1 (Sensor only, no Marker). PATH PINNED: the arithmetic evaluation path in the RETE alpha test, not the compile-time null walk — LNUL.5.1c is the compile-time half and only shows the program is accepted.
rules_ds:
schema Sensor scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    state: Float? mutable

schema Marker scope logical:
    entity_id: String key

rule r:
    Sensor s where s.state + 1 > 5.0
->
    emit Marker logical entity_id: s.entity_id
